operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the nonabelian twisted-norm correction as ledger 1260
operations.body: Ledger 1260 records the nonabelian correction to 1258. For q:G->H, power operations commute with coefficient fiber sum and basis-level fiber lift iff every restricted power map q^-1(h)->q^-1(h^n), equivalently every twisted norm N_{g,n}:ker q->ker q, is bijective. The kernel exponent alone is insufficient: S3->C2 fails at n=2 despite gcd(2,3)=1, while C6->C2 passes. This remains algebraic and supplies no physical relative-chain pushforward. Exact hostile verification: 432 value checks across 12 cases. No build was run.
